purpose: PHP and Symfony development plus real Chromium and Panther browser tests.
limitations: Chromium may need --no-sandbox where the host prohibits sandbox namespaces. Use only for trusted development content.
Node is not included; request a separate capability when the project requires it.

changes: Add opt-in PCOV coverage and reusable lock-owned PHPUnit/PHPStan tasks while retaining Xdebug coverage and default-disabled coverage hooks.
Accept a mounted multi-certificate PEM CA bundle; validate all certificates before replacing managed trust and retain single-certificate and root/user behavior.
8.4-trixie.migration: Compatible additive update. Select a verified new digest before using library-php-tests; PHPUnit/PHPStan versions and configuration continue to come from the consuming project. Set COVERAGE_DRIVER=xdebug for Xdebug coverage. LIBRARY_CA_FILE accepts either a single certificate or a complete validated PEM bundle.
